season.evidence: Logged successful ascents Jun-Oct, peak Sep (7); stored late Jun-early Oct. Searches (Mountaineers, SummitPost, trip logs) found no stricter window; mid-Oct reports describe it dry, snow lingers into early summer. Jul-Sep kept.

facts.text: Early October: a thin snow skim made the SW sub-summit ridge dangerous; skip it unless dry and roped.

notes: Peakbagger coordinate is 464 m off ours because it points at the SW summit; track highs agree our summit pin is the NE (true) summit - do not move. South Gully route not in packet routes (already has a track).
